summary: iOS release delivery refuses to compile missing Nix toolchains. Main-only ARM macOS CI can publish the full iOS Rust toolchain closure to a producer-owned Cachix cache.

compatibility.detail: Cargo and Xcode app compilation are unchanged. Nix realization now disables local, remote and external builders during delivery. Cache publishing is skipped until its repository variable and secret are configured.

downtime.detail: No service restart required; a missing toolchain closure stops delivery before app compilation.

manual.detail: The credential owner must provision a Cachix cache, set the FRACTAL_CACHIX_CACHE repository variable and supply a cache-scoped write token as CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN. Fleet configuration must add that cache to delivery substituters. Workspace preparation also requires its pinned CLI closure in an existing configured cache.

recovery.detail: Populate the cache and retry delivery; revert the change to restore build-on-miss behavior.
